description: Tarot card meanings for The Sun, Judgement and The World (XIX to XXI), upright and reversed, with notes on reading the final major arcana cards in a spread.
lede: Major arcana XIX to XXI cover clarity, calling and completion. Here is what each tarot card traditionally means, upright and reversed.

faces.alt: Three original gold-linework tarot card faces in a row: The Sun XIX, Judgement XX and The World XXI. Each shows its Roman numeral at the top and its name at the bottom with a four-point star, with no scenes or published art.
faces.caption: The final three major arcana in order, from clarity through calling to completion.
